beats.title: Escape from Kharsan
beats.boundaryReason: The opening recap and escape from the bridge form one continuous effort to reach the hidden horses; mounting up changes the objective to desert travel.
dateEvidence: Session drStart anchors May 13; u0001 and u0094 place the opening before noon. u0277 confirms the party has reached its horses.

beats.title: Riding Northwest, Keeping the Lights On
beats.boundaryReason: Choosing Havdar’s camp, riding out, and establishing the first illuminated camp form the first travel day and overnight watch; end before the next morning.
dateEvidence: u0394–u0400: ride northwest toward Havdar’s camp. u0413–u0420: rest of the day passes and first night begins. u0624: just past midnight, moving into May 14.

beats.title: A Wren Finds Water
beats.boundaryReason: A new day brings Kenzo’s recovery, travel, and the wren-guided water search; keep this shorter beat because it lies between a clear waking transition and the ambush watch.
dateEvidence: u0650: everyone wakes after the uneventful first night. u0664–u0670: the second travel day ends and camp begins at twilight. u0739–u0740: it is now night.

beats.title: Shadows in the Light
beats.boundaryReason: The long combat is split at the destruction of both humanoid shadows; the next phase focuses on the shadow dogs and protecting the horses.
dateEvidence: u0780–u0786: Delwath takes the second night’s watch. u0795–u0809: ambush starts around midnight. u1554 later confirms the battle ends just past midnight, so the fight crosses into May 15.

beats.title: The Shadow Dogs Fall
beats.boundaryReason: The remaining combat focuses on the dogs, followed by losses, discussion of Delwath’s powers, the table break, and completion of the interrupted night; end before dawn.
dateEvidence: Continues the same midnight combat. u1554 explicitly places its aftermath just past midnight. u1681–u1699 resume watches and finish the night; the out-of-game break advances no in-world time.

beats.title: Havdar’s Empty Camp
beats.boundaryReason: A distinct day of slower travel ends at the deserted but intact spring camp, where the party consolidates its defenses; the next beat begins at morning.
dateEvidence: u1701: dawn after the ambush. u1722: arrival an hour or two after sunset. u1783–u1785: the evening passes without another attack.

beats.title: A Duty to the Mystai
beats.boundaryReason: Morning tracks reveal Havdar has left, prompting a new destination; the short two-day travel montage stays with that decision and ends before the stone-house reception.
dateEvidence: u1789: the next morning, May 16. u1902: two-day journey to the stone house. u1906: first day passes; u1909–u1911: next day passes and they approach, May 17.

beats.title: Stories at the Stone House
beats.boundaryReason: Arrival, dinner, the exchange of stories and warnings, and the overnight visit are one uninterrupted social situation; end when the return journey montage is announced.
dateEvidence: u1913–u1914: arrival as the sun sets on the second day from Havdar’s camp, May 17. u2212–u2224: they stay the night; no explicit later scene occurs before the montage.

beats.title: Homeward to Karawa
beats.boundaryReason: The final travel montage is a distinct journey and return to Karawa, despite its short transcript length.
dateEvidence: u2212–u2224: overnight stay establishes next-day departure, May 18. u2245–u2246: arrive late afternoon on the sixth travel day, May 23. u2265 says six days after departure; user explicitly chose May 23 and the sixth-travel-day interpretation.
